# Blast Bridge

> Blast Bridge tracks the routes, contracts, timing, and risks for moving ETH and tokens between Ethereum and the Blast Layer 2.

## Key facts
- Route: Ethereum Mainnet  Blast Mainnet (chain ID 81457)
- Deposit: Typically minutes after L1 confirmation
- Withdraw: ~7 days: proving, challenge, finalization
- Gas: ETH is the native asset on both chains
- Custody: Non-custodial — your wallet signs
- Verify: Use official contracts; beware fake bridge sites
